title: The relationship between tourism, economic growth and environmental sustainability: empirical evidence from major tourist destinations
core_idea: To investigate the interconnections and causal relationships among tourism, economic growth, and environmental impact (CO2) in countries listed among the top 10 tourist destinations over 1995–2023, by applying a less-commonly used econometric technique (CS-ARDL) to uncover causality patterns.
tldr: Examines causal links between tourism, economic growth, and environmental sustainability in top tourist destinations (1995–2023) using the CS-ARDL approach to inform policy discussion.
